title: Contact
seoDescription: Contact Kitchen & Flooring Depot in Newington, CT. Call (860) 757-3330, visit our showroom, or request a free quote for kitchens, flooring, and baths.

hero.body: Planning a kitchen remodel, new flooring or a bathroom update? We’re here to help.
hero.backgroundAlt: Ivory wall with olive foliage and natural countertop

intro.heading: Good projects start with a conversation.
intro.body: Whether you’re ready to remodel or still exploring options, our Newington team is happy to help. Reach out by phone, email, or the form — we’ll guide you through materials, design, and next steps.

kitchenImage.alt: Custom kitchen with island seating and warm finishes

form.heading: Tell us about your project.
form.body: Share a few details and our team will get back to you with expert advice and next steps.
form.privacyNote: We’ll use your details to respond to your inquiry.
